description: One row for each school the playlist store holds a policy, an index run, a playlist or a build request for, ordered by state, then school name. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused. Takes no argument, or unitid for one school's row alone. Each row gives unitid, and name and state as the publish this host serves holds them (null where it holds no such school); index, the school's latest academic policy index run as playlist_index_status reads it (status none, running, done or failed; current; publish_version; finished_at; error; policy_pages; left_out); pages_to_read, the count of the page list kept with the policy in use, null where none is kept; last_build, the school's newest build request of either kind by the time it was asked (request_id, rebuild_policy, checklist_id, status, requested_at, error, published_only, timed_out, policy_fallback, attempt_errors, not_read, the counts of policy_warnings and playlist_warnings, policy_pages_read and policy_characters_read), never its learners, null where none is held; policy_in_use, the newest policy that is a draft, not rejected and passed its checks (trust_state, source, created_at), null where none; playlists, the count of the school's checklists with a playlist in use; and open_orders, the count of its rebuild orders open or taken. With unitid, the row also gives playlist_rows: one row for each of the school's checklists with a playlist or a playlist build request, each with checklist_id; award_title and program_name as the publish holds them (null where it holds none); playlist, the playlist in use by the same rule as playlists (playlist_id, policy_id, program_id, trust_state, created_at, warning_count and warnings, its validation's warnings as saved), null where none; and last_build, the checklist's newest build request with the same fields as the school's last_build, null where none. A value the store does not hold is null. Read-only: nothing is built or kept, and no model is called.

unitid.description: Optional: one school, by its IPEDS UNITID; its row alone, with playlist_rows

name: playlist_schools
title: Playlist Schools
